infobox.usage: Unlocks the director's room on the second floor of the boiler building on Customs.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Company director's room key (Company) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: This key must have been used to lock one of the company offices located in the customs terminal area.

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text: - This is a required location for the quest Shipment Tracking

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Drawers
- In Jackets
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Customs
sections.text:
- On the floor next to trash bags opposite the staircase on the third floor of the three-story dorms building.

- In the back of the white van left of the new gas station entrance.

- On the ground next to the partial wall breakthrough from the crane yard to the new gas station.

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Door to the director's room on the second floor of the boiler building on Customs.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- 2x Weapon box (6x6)
- 1x Sports bag
- 2x Drawer
- 2x Safe (locked)
- 1× Intelligence folder spawn
- 1x Poster spawn
